description: This file defines the SagemakerEdgeManagerClient class, which is a client used to interact with the Amazon Sagemaker Edge Manager service, providing methods for deployment, device registration, and heartbeat operations.

classes.name: SagemakerEdgeManagerClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient to provide specific methods for interacting with the Amazon Sagemaker Edge Manager service.

methods.name: getDeployments
methods.description: Retrieves deployment information from the Sagemaker Edge Manager.

methods.name: getDeploymentsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves deployment information from the Sagemaker Edge Manager.

methods.name: sendHeartbeat
methods.description: Sends a heartbeat signal to the Sagemaker Edge Manager.
